name: carbonloop
description: CarbonLoop / TERRAFLUX - Circular Carbon Ecosystem Tracker & Network Operating System

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c green,blue "npm run dev -w packages/frontend" "npm run dev -w packages/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/frontend && npm run build -w packages/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/backend && npm run test -w packages/frontend
